name: Leslie Gates
source:
A caring soul and hospital administrator, Leslie takes her compassionate, ever-protective approach to work and personal life, especially when it comes to the well-being of those close to her. She just wants her loved ones to be safe, happy, and healthy.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
